title: I Made My(one of) Dream Game In Two Weeks
author: Kingnorik
selftext: It will be two weeks tomorrow 6/9 from when I first started this project.  I made this with Codex and Claude and VS code.  The art I've actually had for a very long time over the years of genning with AI.  Just had to get them out to the same style.  Lots of hours poured into it and I'm very proud. I just hope it's fun.  It's an RPG tower defense with a heavy emphasis on loot. My goal is to never power creep characters, because I hate that. Check it out if you want. Feedback much appreciated. I've had the idea in my head for so long and I'm happy AI is there to help me bring it to life.  [Legends And Loot Tower Defense.](https://kingnorik.itch.io/legends-loot-tower-defense)
